scenes.title: 1 / Data and scope · Nunnalin Heimvichit (assigned 20%)
scenes.caption: 5,480 historical NASA records; five requested points; 2023–2025 LST dates. No forecast or comfort/safety claim.

scenes.title: 2 / Six tables and four SQL files · Nunnalin Heimvichit
scenes.caption: Actual schema: weather/location and plan/link foreign keys. Calendar and monthly ingredients remain separate lookups.

scenes.title: 3 / Common filters and Session · Jieun Hwang (assigned 20%)
scenes.caption: Real dates, locations and decimal limits are validated together. The current form can be saved before Apply.

scenes.title: 4 / Complex grouping · Koo Daon (assigned 20%)
scenes.caption: Every point has 31 valid August days. Thresholds classify days; they do not filter the denominator. Seven primary columns stay readable.

scenes.title: 5 / Every SQL statistic remains available · Koo Daon
scenes.caption: More statistics retains maxima/minima, period extremes and matching counts. Values are the original validated SQL results.

scenes.title: 6 / OLAP year to month · Koo Daon
scenes.caption: Drill changes the actual grouping query and intersects the selected comparison dates.

scenes.title: 7 / OLAP day details · Koo Daon
scenes.caption: Five locations × 31 August dates = 155 location-day records. Breadcrumbs return to month and year.

scenes.title: 8 / Dense ranks preserve ties · Jihee Choi (assigned 20%)
scenes.caption: Busan and Daegu both have 2/31 matching days = 6.45%. Top 1 includes both tied rank-1 locations.

scenes.title: 9 / Explain an empty result · Jihee Choi
scenes.caption: A minimum of 32 valid days cannot be met inside a 31-day month. No result is fabricated.

scenes.title: 10 / Direct SQL-value chart · Jihee Choi
scenes.caption: Daily, 7-day and 30-day values come from MariaDB. Focus changes emphasis; PHP does not recalculate averages.

scenes.title: 11 / Graph-only location selection · Jihee Choi
scenes.caption: The graph shows Busan while both Seoul and Busan remain selected in the comparison. Calendar spacing, NULL gaps and finite single-day points are tested.

scenes.title: 12 / Continuous December history · Jihee Choi
scenes.caption: Seoul January 1: 7-day average 1.14°C, 30-day 0.30°C. The internal query includes December 2023 before trimming display dates.

scenes.title: 13 / Save the unapplied current form · Jieun Hwang / Sumin Cho
scenes.caption: The changed end date January 3 is forwarded to Create a Plan before a permanent INSERT. Validation precedes Session changes.

scenes.title: 14 / Real create and read · Sumin Cho (assigned 20%)
scenes.caption: This plan is persisted in the disposable MariaDB database. The literal memo "0" is visible. Parent and selected locations committed together.

scenes.title: 15 / Region-only update · Sumin Cho
scenes.caption: Only the region selection changed. The parent updated_at explicitly advances; failed replacements restore body, links and timestamp atomically.

scenes.title: 16 / Apply persistent conditions to Session · Sumin Cho / Jieun Hwang
scenes.caption: The saved January 1–3 period and selected locations reappear in Ranking. Page-specific presentation options remain separate.

scenes.title: 17 / Real delete and cascading links · Sumin Cho
scenes.caption: The demonstration plan is deleted. Unrelated plans and all reference/weather records are preserved.

scenes.title: 18 / Independent seasonal references · Jieun Hwang
scenes.caption: February 2025 starts with the February 3 calendar reference. Ingredients use a separate month query and do not multiply weather rows.

scenes.title: 19 / Actual middle-step FK failures · Sumin Cho
scenes.caption: Recorded CLI results: parent/first child succeed, later FK fails, rollback leaves no residues; failing update restores the original snapshot.

scenes.title: 20 / Reproduce this application version · Shared closing
scenes.caption: Fresh offline Apache/MariaDB and official XAMPP passed. App e12ee89cd599. Each member has 20% responsibility; actual oral delivery and course upload remain NOT_RUN.
